html_bullets.point: Hindustan Unilever is focusing on improving volume growth and has indicated a willingness to reduce margins to enhance long-term consumer franchise health, despite current pressures on earnings.

Hindustan Unilever reported stronger-than-expected earnings and forecasted a pick-up in demand among urban consumers, with CEO Rohit Jawa anticipating gradual improvement in demand conditions over the next fiscal year.
Hindustan Unilever is anticipated to face heightened competition from increased imports of affordable beauty products following the India-UK free trade agreement.
HUL's managing director noted a robust demand in rural areas and expressed optimism about future consumption growth, particularly with expectations of a good monsoon and crop yield.
